reason: A sidebar and bottom-panel workbench for DSH that combines file management and previews, a real terminal, Git controls, embedded browsing, task and conversation views, and extension APIs for registering tabs and file viewers.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供集文件管理、编辑预览、真实终端、Git、内嵌浏览器、任务与侧边对话于一体的侧边栏和底部面板工作台，并支持插件注册新页面和文件预览器。
summaries.en: A DSH sidebar and bottom-panel workbench that combines file management and previews, a real terminal, Git, embedded browsing, task and chat views, and APIs for plugins to register tabs and file viewers.

capabilities: Provides a sidebar and bottom-panel workbench
Displays, edits, uploads, and previews files
Runs a real shell through node-pty
Provides Git staging, commit, revert, history, and diff views
Displays sub-agent and background-task status, output, and termination controls
Exposes APIs for third-party sidebar tabs and file viewers
